verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents Datasets as reusable test-case sets, experiments run via SDK (`run_experiment`) and in CI/CD, and programmatic read-back through the Query SDKs, Scores via API/SDK, and the Metrics API for score metrics. It also offers a CLI aimed at coding agents and an MCP server for AI tools, so an agent has interfaces to drive this loop. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of creating datasets via API/SDK, explicit evidence that the CLI/MCP server covers dataset and experiment operations, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the end-to-end workflow.
